sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Generative AI for Beginners is a free 21-lesson course from Microsoft Cloud Advocates on building generative AI applications. Lessons explain concepts and include code in Python and TypeScript.
sixtySeconds.problem: Getting started with generative AI is confusing because of the many models, APIs and techniques. This course walks through the fundamentals one topic at a time, with hands-on build lessons.
whoFor: Students learning to build AI apps
Teams onboarding people to LLM development
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a structured, free course backed by Microsoft that you can start at any lesson. Some lessons use Azure or OpenAI services, though Foundry Local lets you run models offline.
requirements: Basic Python or TypeScript knowledge helps
A GitHub account to fork the repo
Access to Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry Models, the OpenAI API, or Foundry Local

overview: The course has 21 standalone lessons, so you can start wherever you like. Learn lessons explain a generative AI concept, and Build lessons add code examples in Python and TypeScript where possible. Each lesson includes a short video introduction and a Keep Learning section.

To run the code you can use Azure OpenAI Service, Microsoft Foundry Models, the OpenAI API, or Foundry Local to run models fully offline. The README notes GitHub Models was retired at the end of July 2026 and Microsoft Foundry Models replaces it.

A Course Setup lesson helps you set up your development environment. The repository includes translations into 50+ languages, so the README suggests a sparse clone to skip them. There is also a separate .NET edition.

install.verificationNote: Commands come from Generative AI for Beginners's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Clone without translations
steps.code:
git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners.git
cd generative-ai-for-beginners
git sparse-checkout set --no-cone '/*' '!translations' '!translated_images'
